div.head: Northu 61
div.ab: And we forbeodað on Godes forbode, þæt nan man na ma wifa næbbe buton I; ⁊ seo beo mid rihte beweddod ⁊ forgifen;
And we forbeodað on Godes forbode, þæt nan man na ma wifa næbbe buton I; and seo beo mid rihte beweddod and forgifen.
Und wir verbieten kraft Gottes Verbot, dass ein Mann nicht mehr Weiber als eines habe; und diese sei rechtmässig verlobt und angetraut;
And we forbid, by God's prohibition, that any man have more wives than one; and let her be lawfully betrothed and given [in marriage];
And by virtue of God's prohibition we forbid that any man should have more wives than one; and she is to be legally betrothed and wedded;
And on account of God’s prohibition, we forbid any man to have more than one wife, and she is to be properly promised and wedded.
div.note: Some of Liebermann’s notes here are cut off in the gutter of the scan used, and are still to be completed.
Another hand has drawn a stroke over ‘na’, making it ‘nan’, which editors adopt against Cnut. Liebermann compares I Cn 7.

note.seg: darüber von anderer Hand Strich, also nan, was Edd. gegen Cnut aufnehmen
above it a stroke in another hand, hence nan, which the Edd. adopt against Cnut
